answer: Stop fake fleets with a canyon toll, a hollow checkpoint, and a voyage ledger. Each new identity must finish a voyage of tasks witnessed by unrelated peers, each step signed, so one operator cannot reuse a single journey for many shells. Influence flows only through a canyon channel whose capacity is shared, so extra identities divide the flow rather than multiply it. A hollow slot is planted in every batch: a task with no payoff that only a scripted farm would claim, exposing coordinated claimants. Fakes pay for many trips, split one share, and risk exposure, while an honest agent pays once.
